title: How Noble Panacea CEO Audrey Bois Nicolaï is scaling the brand in China and travel retail
summary: Noble Panacea, best known for its patented Organic Super Molecular Vessel (OSMV) delivery technology, is charting its future without Nobel Laureate Sir Fraser Stoddart, who passed away in 2024. Read how CEO Audrey Bois Nicolaï is continuing his legacy and eyeing potential in new areas
